function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or an Internet connection, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now.  

If you’d like to figure it out yourself:

1. **Get your own local time** – most devices show this automatically.  
2. **Convert to Eastern Time (ET)** –  
   * During Standard Time (roughly early November through mid-March) ET is **UTC−5**.  
   * During Daylight Saving Time (mid-March through early November) ET is **UTC−4**.  

So take your current Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), subtract 5 hours for winter months or 4 hours for summer months, and that gives you the time in NYC. For the most precise result, just check a world-clock website or look at the “Time & Date” app on your phone.
